/* RealMapper.selectTotal 전체 현황 - 현재 시간 기준 */
SELECT ISNULL(REPLACE(SUBSTRING(CONVERT(CHAR(8), GETDATE(), 8), 4, 8), ':', ''), '00:00') AS IN_TIME , ISNULL(SUM(SEND_CNT), 0) AS SEND_CNT FROM T_MSG_TRAFFIC WHERE IN_TIME <= GETDATE() AND IN_TIME >= DATEADD(N, -#{totalMonTime}, GETDATE())

/* RealMapper.selectRealHistServiceStatusSummaryListBackup 서비스 / 프로세스 요약 */ WITH PROC_DATA AS ( SELECT CASE WHEN PROC_NAME LIKE '%DBP%' THEN 'DBP' WHEN PROC_NAME LIKE '%IFP%' THEN 'IFP' WHEN PROC_NAME LIKE '%MEMMON%' THEN 'MON' WHEN PROC_NAME LIKE '%STATP%' THEN 'SAP' ELSE 'ETC' END AS PROC_TYPE, COMPANY_CODE, SVC_NAME, MIN(PROC_STS) AS PROC_STS, MAX(UPDATE_DATE) AS UPDATE_DATE FROM T_PROC_STATUS WHERE SERVER_ID = #{tab} GROUP BY COMPANY_CODE, SVC_NAME, PROC_NAME ), STATUS_DATA AS ( SELECT COMPANY_CODE, PROC_TYPE, CASE -- 5분 이상 미갱신 WHEN DATEDIFF(MINUTE, UPDATE_DATE, GETDATE()) > 5 THEN 'N' -- 하나라도 OFF WHEN PROC_STS = 0 THEN 'F' -- 모두 ON WHEN PROC_STS = 1 THEN 'T' END AS FLAG FROM PROC_DATA ) SELECT COMPANY_CODE,
-- DBP ISNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN PROC_TYPE = 'DBP' AND FLAG = 'T' THEN 1 END), 0) AS DB_NORMAL_COUNT, ISNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN PROC_TYPE = 'DBP' AND FLAG = 'F' THEN 1 END), 0) AS DB_WARN_COUNT, ISNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN PROC_TYPE = 'DBP' AND FLAG = 'N' THEN 1 END), 0) AS DB_DOWN_COUNT,
-- IFP ISNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN PROC_TYPE = 'IFP' AND FLAG = 'T' THEN 1 END), 0) AS IFP_NORMAL_COUNT, ISNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN PROC_TYPE = 'IFP' AND FLAG = 'F' THEN 1 END), 0) AS IFP_WARN_COUNT, ISNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN PROC_TYPE = 'IFP' AND FLAG = 'N' THEN 1 END), 0) AS IFP_DOWN_COUNT,
-- MON ISNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN PROC_TYPE = 'MON' AND FLAG = 'T' THEN 1 END), 0) AS MON_NORMAL_COUNT, ISNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN PROC_TYPE = 'MON' AND FLAG = 'F' THEN 1 END), 0) AS MON_WARN_COUNT, ISNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN PROC_TYPE = 'MON' AND FLAG = 'N' THEN 1 END), 0) AS MON_DOWN_COUNT,
-- SAP ISNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN PROC_TYPE = 'SAP' AND FLAG = 'T' THEN 1 END), 0) AS SAP_NORMAL_COUNT, ISNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN PROC_TYPE = 'SAP' AND FLAG = 'F' THEN 1 END), 0) AS SAP_WARN_COUNT, ISNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN PROC_TYPE = 'SAP' AND FLAG = 'N' THEN 1 END), 0) AS SAP_DOWN_COUNT
FROM STATUS_DATA GROUP BY COMPANY_CODE

/* RealMapper.selectRealHistServiceStatusDetailListBackup 서비스 / 프로세스 상세 */ SELECT COMPANY_CODE , SVC_NAME , PROC_NAME , PROC_TYPE , DB_SESH_CHK, DB_SESH_STS, DB_UPDATE_DOWN , KT_SESH_CHK, KT_SESH_STS, KT_UPDATE_DOWN , SW_DOWN_CHK, SW_DOWN_STS, SW_UPDATE_DOWN FROM ( SELECT COMPANY_CODE, SVC_NAME, PROC_NAME, CASE WHEN PROC_NAME LIKE '%DBP%' THEN 'DBP' WHEN PROC_NAME LIKE '%IFP%' THEN 'IFP' WHEN PROC_NAME LIKE '%MEMMON%' THEN 'MON' WHEN PROC_NAME LIKE '%STATP%' THEN 'SAP' END AS PROC_TYPE,
-- DB ISNULL(MAX(CASE WHEN MON_TYPE = 1 THEN 1 END), 9999) AS DB_SESH_CHK, ISNULL(MAX(CASE WHEN MON_TYPE = 1 THEN PROC_STS END), 9999) AS DB_SESH_STS, -- 5분 이상 MIN(CASE WHEN MON_TYPE = 1 AND DATEDIFF(MINUTE, UPDATE_DATE, GETDATE()) > 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DB_UPDATE_DOWN,
-- KT ISNULL(MAX(CASE WHEN MON_TYPE = 2 THEN 2 END), 9999) AS KT_SESH_CHK, ISNULL(MAX(CASE WHEN MON_TYPE = 2 THEN PROC_STS END), 9999) AS KT_SESH_STS, -- 5분 이상 MIN(CASE WHEN MON_TYPE = 2 AND DATEDIFF(MINUTE, UPDATE_DATE, GETDATE()) > 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS KT_UPDATE_DOWN,
-- SW ISNULL(MAX(CASE WHEN MON_TYPE = 3 THEN 3 END), 9999) AS SW_DOWN_CHK, ISNULL(MAX(CASE WHEN MON_TYPE = 3 THEN PROC_STS END), 9999) AS SW_DOWN_STS, -- 5분 이상 MIN(CASE WHEN MON_TYPE = 3 AND DATEDIFF(MINUTE, UPDATE_DATE, GETDATE()) > 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS SW_UPDATE_DOWN
FROM T_PROC_STATUS WHERE SERVER_ID = #{tab} GROUP BY COMPANY_CODE, SVC_NAME, PROC_NAME ) T ORDER BY COMPANY_CODE

/* RealMapper.selectRealHistServiceStatusSummaryList 서비스 / 프로세스 요약 STATUS: NORMAL / DELAY / ISSUE / DOWN (Summary 기준 통일) */ WITH PROC_DATA AS ( SELECT CASE WHEN PROC_NAME LIKE '%DBP%' THEN 'DBP' WHEN PROC_NAME LIKE '%IFP%' THEN 'IFP' WHEN PROC_NAME LIKE '%MEMMON%' THEN 'MON' WHEN PROC_NAME LIKE '%STATP%' THEN 'SAP' ELSE 'ETC' END AS PROC_TYPE, COMPANY_CODE, SVC_NAME, PROC_NAME, MIN(PROC_STS) AS MIN_PROC_STS, MAX(UPDATE_DATE) AS LAST_UPDATE_DATE FROM T_PROC_STATUS WHERE SERVER_ID = #{tab} GROUP BY COMPANY_CODE, SVC_NAME, PROC_NAME ), STATUS_DATA AS ( SELECT COMPANY_CODE, PROC_TYPE, CASE -- DOWN: 5분 이상 미갱신 WHEN DATEDIFF(MINUTE, LAST_UPDATE_DATE, GETDATE()) >= 5 THEN 'DOWN' -- ISSUE: 하나라도 OFF WHEN MIN_PROC_STS = 0 THEN 'ISSUE' -- DELAY: 1~4분 미갱신 WHEN DATEDIFF(MINUTE, LAST_UPDATE_DATE, GETDATE()) BETWEEN 1 AND 4 THEN 'DELAY' -- NORMAL ELSE 'NORMAL' END AS STATUS FROM PROC_DATA ) SELECT COMPANY_CODE,
-- DBP SUM(CASE WHEN PROC_TYPE = 'DBP' AND STATUS = 'NORMAL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DB_NORMAL_COUNT, SUM(CASE WHEN PROC_TYPE = 'DBP' AND STATUS IN ('DELAY','ISSUE') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DB_WARN_COUNT, SUM(CASE WHEN PROC_TYPE = 'DBP' AND STATUS = 'DOWN' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DB_DOWN_COUNT,
-- IFP SUM(CASE WHEN PROC_TYPE = 'IFP' AND STATUS = 'NORMAL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS IFP_NORMAL_COUNT, SUM(CASE WHEN PROC_TYPE = 'IFP' AND STATUS IN ('DELAY','ISSUE') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS IFP_WARN_COUNT, SUM(CASE WHEN PROC_TYPE = 'IFP' AND STATUS = 'DOWN' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS IFP_DOWN_COUNT,
-- MON SUM(CASE WHEN PROC_TYPE = 'MON' AND STATUS = 'NORMAL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS MON_NORMAL_COUNT, SUM(CASE WHEN PROC_TYPE = 'MON' AND STATUS IN ('DELAY','ISSUE') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS MON_WARN_COUNT, SUM(CASE WHEN PROC_TYPE = 'MON' AND STATUS = 'DOWN' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS MON_DOWN_COUNT,
-- SAP SUM(CASE WHEN PROC_TYPE = 'SAP' AND STATUS = 'NORMAL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS SAP_NORMAL_COUNT, SUM(CASE WHEN PROC_TYPE = 'SAP' AND STATUS IN ('DELAY','ISSUE') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS SAP_WARN_COUNT, SUM(CASE WHEN PROC_TYPE = 'SAP' AND STATUS = 'DOWN' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS SAP_DOWN_COUNT
FROM STATUS_DATA GROUP BY COMPANY_CODE

/* RealMapper.selectRealHistServiceStatusDetailList 서비스 / 프로세스 상세 STATUS: NORMAL / DELAY / ISSUE / DOWN (Summary 기준 통일) */ SELECT COMPANY_CODE , SVC_NAME , PROC_NAME , PROC_TYPE , DB_SESH_CHK, DB_SESH_STS, DB_UPDATE_DOWN, DB_UPDATE_DELAY , KT_SESH_CHK, KT_SESH_STS, KT_UPDATE_DOWN, KT_UPDATE_DELAY , SW_DOWN_CHK, SW_DOWN_STS, SW_UPDATE_DOWN, SW_UPDATE_DELAY FROM ( SELECT COMPANY_CODE, SVC_NAME, PROC_NAME, CASE WHEN PROC_NAME LIKE '%DBP%' THEN 'DBP' WHEN PROC_NAME LIKE '%IFP%' THEN 'IFP' WHEN PROC_NAME LIKE '%MEMMON%' THEN 'MON' WHEN PROC_NAME LIKE '%STATP%' THEN 'SAP' END AS PROC_TYPE,
-- DB ISNULL(MAX(CASE WHEN MON_TYPE = 1 THEN 1 END), 9999) AS DB_SESH_CHK, ISNULL(MAX(CASE WHEN MON_TYPE = 1 THEN PROC_STS END), 9999) AS DB_SESH_STS, -- 5분 이상 MAX(CASE WHEN MON_TYPE = 1 AND DATEDIFF(MINUTE, UPDATE_DATE, GETDATE()) >= 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DB_UPDATE_DOWN, -- 1~4분 미갱신 MAX(CASE WHEN MON_TYPE = 1 AND DATEDIFF(MINUTE, UPDATE_DATE, GETDATE()) BETWEEN 1 AND 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DB_UPDATE_DELAY,
-- KT ISNULL(MAX(CASE WHEN MON_TYPE = 2 THEN 2 END), 9999) AS KT_SESH_CHK, ISNULL(MAX(CASE WHEN MON_TYPE = 2 THEN PROC_STS END), 9999) AS KT_SESH_STS, -- 5분 이상 MAX(CASE WHEN MON_TYPE = 2 AND DATEDIFF(MINUTE, UPDATE_DATE, GETDATE()) >= 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS KT_UPDATE_DOWN, -- 1~4분 미갱신 MAX(CASE WHEN MON_TYPE = 2 AND DATEDIFF(MINUTE, UPDATE_DATE, GETDATE()) BETWEEN 1 AND 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS KT_UPDATE_DELAY,
-- SW ISNULL(MAX(CASE WHEN MON_TYPE = 3 THEN 3 END), 9999) AS SW_DOWN_CHK, ISNULL(MAX(CASE WHEN MON_TYPE = 3 THEN PROC_STS END), 9999) AS SW_DOWN_STS, -- 5분 이상 MAX(CASE WHEN MON_TYPE = 3 AND DATEDIFF(MINUTE, UPDATE_DATE, GETDATE()) >= 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS SW_UPDATE_DOWN, -- 1~4분 미갱신 MAX(CASE WHEN MON_TYPE = 3 AND DATEDIFF(MINUTE, UPDATE_DATE, GETDATE()) BETWEEN 1 AND 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS SW_UPDATE_DELAY
FROM T_PROC_STATUS WHERE SERVER_ID = #{tab} GROUP BY COMPANY_CODE, SVC_NAME, PROC_NAME ) T ORDER BY COMPANY_CODE
mapper.sql: WITH ACTIVE_SERVER AS ( SELECT COMPANY_CODE, SERVER_ID FROM T_SERVER_STATUS WHERE SERVER_STAT = 'A' ), PROC_DATA AS ( SELECT P.COMPANY_CODE, P.SVC_NAME, P.PROC_NAME, -- OFF 포함 여부 MIN(P.PROC_STS) AS MIN_PROC_STS, -- 5분 이상 미갱신 MIN( CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(MINUTE, P.UPDATE_DATE, GETDATE()) >= 5 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END ) AS HAS_OVER_5MIN, -- 1~4분 미갱신 MAX( CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(MINUTE, P.UPDATE_DATE, GETDATE()) BETWEEN 1 AND 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS HAS_DELAY_1_4 FROM T_PROC_STATUS P JOIN ACTIVE_SERVER S ON P.COMPANY_CODE = S.COMPANY_CODE AND P.SERVER_ID = S.SERVER_ID GROUP BY P.COMPANY_CODE, P.SVC_NAME, P.PROC_NAME ), STATUS_DATA AS ( SELECT COMPANY_CODE, SVC_NAME, PROC_NAME, CASE WHEN HAS_OVER_5MIN = 0 THEN 'DOWN' WHEN MIN_PROC_STS = 0 THEN 'ISSUE' WHEN HAS_DELAY_1_4 = 1 THEN 'DELAY' ELSE 'NORMAL' END AS STATUS FROM PROC_DATA )
mapper.select:
/* RealMapper.selectSummaryProcCount 서비스 상태별 카운트 조회 전체 118: 옥션 56 + G마켓 62 (스마일캐시 8 제외) */
SELECT COUNT(*) AS TOTAL_COUNT, SUM(CASE WHEN STATUS = 'NORMAL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS NORMAL_COUNT, SUM(CASE WHEN STATUS = 'DOWN' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DOWN_COUNT, SUM(CASE WHEN STATUS = 'ISSUE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ISSUE_COUNT, SUM(CASE WHEN STATUS = 'DELAY' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DELAY_COUNT FROM STATUS_DATA

/* RealMapper.selectSummaryProcName 서비스 상태별 서비스명 조회 */
SELECT COMPANY_CODE, SVC_NAME FROM STATUS_DATA WHERE STATUS = #{status} GROUP BY COMPANY_CODE, SVC_NAME ORDER BY COMPANY_CODE, SVC_NAME

/* RealMapper.selectTrafficSummary 총 발송량 조회 */ SELECT SUM(T.SEND_CNT) AS ALL_SEND_CNT, SUM(T.SUCC_CNT) AS ALL_SUCC_CNT, SUM(T.FAIL_CNT) AS ALL_FAIL_CNT, CASE WHEN SUM(T.SEND_CNT) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND( (SUM(T.SUCC_CNT) * 100.0) / SUM(T.SEND_CNT), 2 ) END AS ALL_COMPLETE_RATE FROM T_MSG_TRAFFIC T WHERE T.IN_TIME >= CONVERT(date, GETDATE()) AND T.IN_TIME < DATEADD(day, 1, CONVERT(date, GETDATE()))

/* RealMapper.selectTrafficDetail 발송량 상세 조회 */ SELECT -- 옥션(AU) SUM(CASE WHEN L.COMPANY_CODE = 0 THEN T.SEND_CNT ELSE 0 END) AS AU_SEND_CNT, SUM(CASE WHEN L.COMPANY_CODE = 0 THEN T.SUCC_CNT ELSE 0 END) AS AU_SUCC_CNT, SUM(CASE WHEN L.COMPANY_CODE = 0 THEN T.FAIL_CNT ELSE 0 END) AS AU_FAIL_CNT, CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN L.COMPANY_CODE = 0 THEN T.SEND_CNT ELSE 0 END) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND( SUM(CASE WHEN L.COMPANY_CODE = 0 THEN T.SUCC_CNT ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN L.COMPANY_CODE = 0 THEN T.SEND_CNT ELSE 0 END), 2 ) END AS AU_COMPLETE_RATE,
-- G마켓(GM) SUM(CASE WHEN L.COMPANY_CODE = 1 THEN T.SEND_CNT ELSE 0 END) AS GM_SEND_CNT, SUM(CASE WHEN L.COMPANY_CODE = 1 THEN T.SUCC_CNT ELSE 0 END) AS GM_SUCC_CNT, SUM(CASE WHEN L.COMPANY_CODE = 1 THEN T.FAIL_CNT ELSE 0 END) AS GM_FAIL_CNT, CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN L.COMPANY_CODE = 1 THEN T.SEND_CNT ELSE 0 END) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND( SUM(CASE WHEN L.COMPANY_CODE = 1 THEN T.SUCC_CNT ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN L.COMPANY_CODE = 1 THEN T.SEND_CNT ELSE 0 END), 2 ) END AS GM_COMPLETE_RATE,
-- 스마일캐시(SC) SUM(CASE WHEN L.COMPANY_CODE = 2 THEN T.SEND_CNT ELSE 0 END) AS SC_SEND_CNT, SUM(CASE WHEN L.COMPANY_CODE = 2 THEN T.SUCC_CNT ELSE 0 END) AS SC_SUCC_CNT, SUM(CASE WHEN L.COMPANY_CODE = 2 THEN T.FAIL_CNT ELSE 0 END) AS SC_FAIL_CNT, CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN L.COMPANY_CODE = 2 THEN T.SEND_CNT ELSE 0 END) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND( SUM(CASE WHEN L.COMPANY_CODE = 2 THEN T.SUCC_CNT ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN L.COMPANY_CODE = 2 THEN T.SEND_CNT ELSE 0 END), 2 ) END AS SC_COMPLETE_RATE
FROM T_MSG_TRAFFIC T JOIN T_TCODE_LIST L ON T.TABLE_CODE = L.TABLE_CODE AND L.DEL_FLAG = 'N' AND L.USE_YN = 'Y'
WHERE T.IN_TIME >= CONVERT(date, GETDATE()) AND T.IN_TIME < DATEADD(day, 1, CONVERT(date, GETDATE())) AND L.COMPANY_CODE IN (0, 1, 2)
/* RealMapper.selectServerStatusList 서버 상태 목록 조회 */ SELECT COMPANY_CODE , SERVER_ID , SERVER_STAT , MANUAL_FLAG FROM T_SERVER_STATUS

/* RealMapper.selectDownCount 프로세스 다운 상태 조회 */ SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM T_SERVER_STATUS me JOIN T_SERVER_STATUS other ON me.COMPANY_CODE = other.COMPANY_CODE AND me.SERVER_ID <> other.SERVER_ID WHERE me.COMPANY_CODE = #{companyCode} AND me.SERVER_ID = #{serverId} AND me.SERVER_STAT = 'A' AND other.SERVER_STAT = 'D' ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS DOWN_CNT
